                weighted = weighted + rate * latency
                weighted_tail = weighted_tail + rate * tail * tail
                pressure = min(queue_cost, 12.0) + min(neighbor_queue, 12.0)
                weighted_interaction = weighted_interaction + rate * latency / 45.0 * pressure
                weight = weight + rate
                if destination == pod.id:
                    incoming_longest = max(incoming_longest, latency)
                else:
                    outgoing_longest = max(outgoing_longest, latency)

    mean_latency = 0.0
    mean_tail = 0.0
    interaction = 0.0
    if weight > 0.0:
        mean_latency = weighted / weight
        mean_tail = weighted_tail / weight
        interaction = weighted_interaction / weight

    # Incoming and outgoing delays can both lie on a serving path.
    path_latency = incoming_longest + outgoing_longest
    path_tail = max(path_latency - 30.0, 0.0) / 45.0
    latency_cost = mean_latency / 45.0 * 1.10
    latency_cost = latency_cost + path_latency / 45.0 * 0.45
    latency_cost = latency_cost + mean_tail * 0.80
    latency_cost = latency_cost + path_tail * path_tail * 0.45
    latency_cost = latency_cost + interaction * 0.10

    # Charge incremental draw and the idle draw of newly occupied capacity.
    before = max(cpu_before, mem_before)
    incremental_load = max(peak - before, 0.0)
    incremental_power = max(node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w, 0.0) * incremental_load
    if node.suspendable and node.cpu_allocated == 0 and node.mem_allocated == 0:
        incremental_power = incremental_power + node.power_idle_w

    cost = queue_cost * 0.35 + burst_cost + latency_cost
    cost = cost + incremental_power / 120.0 * 0.25
    return -cost
